# hivelocity_contact (Data Source)

Looks up one of your account contacts, typically by `email`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_contact" "oncall" {
  filter {
    name   = "email"
    values = ["oncall@example.com"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter the results. Every filter block must match (logical AND); a block matches when the attribute named by `name` equals any of `values`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `first` (Boolean) When true (the default) return the first match instead of erroring when more than one item matches the filters.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Number) 1 when the contact is active, 0 otherwise.
- `client_id` (Number) Owning client ID.
- `contact_id` (Number) Unique ID of the contact.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `full_name` (String) Full name.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_client` (Boolean) True for the primary account contact.
- `phone` (String) Phone number.
- `referral_code` (String) Referral code.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) Attribute name to filter on
- `values` (List of String) Accepted values for the attribute
